---
title: "Species resolution"
---

```{python}
from _lib import *
sp = read("inventory_species")
rev = read("species_review")
```

Raw taxon names and codes are resolved in two passes (`src/leafrtm/db/species.py`):

1. **USDA PLANTS.** Names and USDA codes are cleaned to binomials and matched against the
   USDA PLANTS checklist distributed with `spectra_db`. Every name *not* found there was
   reviewed by hand; the decisions are committed in `vocab/species_resolution.csv`.
2. **GBIF backbone.** After the bulk of the work, every resolved name was re-checked against
   the GBIF backbone taxonomy (`vocab/species_gbif.csv`: accepted name, status, family, match
   type).

```{python}
if len(sp):
    stats([(f"{len(sp):,}", "resolved taxa"), (f"{sp['family'].nunique()}", "families")])
    show_table(sp[["scientific_name", "family", "growth_form", "leaf_type", "n_observations", "datasets"]]
               .sort_values("n_observations", ascending=False))
```
